instruction: Install and configure Varnish with multiple backends
output:
<think>
This is asking us to install and configure Varnish with multiple backends.
Let me think through this step by step.
Best tool here is cat — cat operations.
Using && for chaining ensures if any step fails, the whole thing stops — safer than running separately.
</think>
cat > /etc/varnish/default.vcl << 'EOF'
vcl 4.1;
backend web1 { .host = "192.168.1.10"; .port = "80"; }
backend web2 { .host = "192.168.1.11"; .port = "80"; }
sub vcl_recv {
  set req.backend_hint = web1;
  if (req.restarts > 0) { set req.backend_hint = web2; }
}
sub vcl_backend_response {
  set beresp.grace = 1h;
}
EOF && systemctl reload varnish
